svg.title: Puzzle 20: The Granny's Downfall - Setup
svg.desc: Two closed cord loops, each showing six crossings in two three-crossing clumps joined by a two-strand neck, above a printed mold board whose carved channel is the flattened square-knot diagram with a bridge at each of the six crossings.
svg.text: same outline, same crossing count - the loops differ only in three over-unders
